diagnosis.llm_reason: Rank 1 'Septic shock with multi-organ failure' names the same principal condition as the physician discharge diagnosis 'Other specified sepsis' — a systemic septic process; septic shock is a more specific/severe manifestation of the same sepsis episode. No lower-numbered rank matches, and remaining ranks (hepatic encephalopathy, liver failure, GI bleeding, coagulopathy, atrial fibrillation, pleural effusion, bipolar disorder) are distinct organ-specific conditions or complications.
